name: one-arm-reverse-dumbbell-wrist-curl-over-bench.html
instructions:
1. Grasp a dumbbell using a reverse grip (palms facing down) and kneel down in front of a flat bench.
2. Rest the back of your forearm on top of the bench so that the wrist holding the dumbbell is just off the end of it.
3. Bending only at the wrist, let the dumbbell drop as far as possible. You can rest your non-working arm on the bench for stability. This is the starting position for the exercise.
4. Slowly raise the dumbbell up as far as possible squeezing the forearm muscles at the top of the movement.
5. Pause, and then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
6. Repeat for desired reps.
